checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: AU ruler tick labels reserve their rectangle in the radar label collision list so body and flagship names route around them; failing-first pin and 720p/1080p captures

impact_assessment.why: Real Edge at 1280x720: the VF-FLAGSHIP label sits on the 13.0 AU ruler mark; tick text is drawn without registering in the collision list
impact_assessment.benefits: Names and ruler marks stay legible together
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: ticks reserve space so a crowded map may drop a variant to its short name; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Compare label counts before and after at 720p and 1080p; priority-4 labels still always drawn

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: the creation origin tag shows the gain the rank-10 cap leaves, and 'ORIGIN MAXED' when none; failing-first pin and browser check

impact_assessment.why: Real Edge: maxing Engineering as an Engineer leaves it at 10 because origin training is capped at rank 10, yet the tag still promised +2 ORIGIN
impact_assessment.benefits: Players see what the origin will really add before spending points
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: cap mirrors character.py's rank-10 rule, pinned by a test; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Test ties the UI cap to the engine rule text; browser check at 9, 10 and low values

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: compress the archetype price swing and the stock-factor clamp so the best neighbouring-market lane pays at most about 2x while ordinary good lanes stay profitable; re-measure credit trajectories

impact_assessment.why: Measured: a greedy trader compounds 2,000 to ~17k by trip 3 and ~86k by trip 8 on lanes up to 3.05x; every ship (4.5k to 12k), upgrade (max 2.6k) and escort (max 9.8k) is bought within a few jumps
impact_assessment.benefits: Progression content stays meaningful for far longer; route-finding still pays
impact_assessment.risks: contract: quotes and API unchanged in shape, values change; dependency: tests that pin exact prices; concurrency: none; state: saves keep stockpiles, prices shift after load
impact_assessment.mitigation: Full suite and mechanics gate; tail-gap test; before/after trajectory measurement recorded in the ADR

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: M1 engine adds cost_basis and profit to each quantum route (net unchanged); M2 cockpit shows and colours by profit as a UI task

impact_assessment.why: 4K capture: 'Quantum Substrates x2 ... +811 CR NET' reads as profit but net is payout minus fee, ignoring the ~736 the cargo cost (real profit about +75); green colouring follows net
impact_assessment.benefits: Freight rows stop overstating gains; players can tell a losing shipment from a winning one
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive fields, net and the auto-freight min-net threshold keep their meaning; dependency: cargo_cost per commodity; concurrency: read under the engine lock; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for both cost-known and cost-unknown cargo; existing automation tests rerun

checkpoints.description: [2/2] cockpit freight profit Phase 4 (fixed test_freight_profit_ui slice index)
[1/1] Plan: unify top-bar audio button icon (◉/◌), opacity and aria-pressed across toggle, loadSettings and applySettingsFromUI; failing-first unit test and browser check

impact_assessment.why: applySettingsFromUI sets #audioIcon to 'SFX'/'MUTED' (producing 'SFX SOUND FX') without updating button opacity, and loadSettings sets 'MUTED' instead of '◌'
impact_assessment.benefits: Top-bar SOUND FX button keeps its ◉/◌ icon, opacity and aria-pressed state whether toggled directly, loaded from storage, or changed in Settings
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: localStorage settings unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first test pinning syncAudioButton and browser verification before/after opening Settings

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Unify #audioToggleBtn icon/opacity/aria-pressed via syncAudioControlState(), resolve readable system/commodity/tree names and accurate Codex claimed % in app.js, and fix card line-clamp bleed, character profile clipping, and Factions WCAG AA contrast in style.css and app.js

impact_assessment.why: Real-Edge visual and DOM audits showed #audioIcon mutating to SFX/MUTED after Settings changes, raw system/commodity/tree IDs across AI/Depot/Story/Empire/Factions/Save/Messages views, contradictory 0 / 62 CLAIMED (3%) in Codex, Chromium line-clamp+overflow:visible text bleed on mercenary cards, right-edge clipping on .character-profile at 1280x720, and 4.36:1 contrast on Precursor Watch (#8b5cf6)
impact_assessment.benefits: Consistent audio button indicator, human-readable star system and commodity names across all cockpit tabs, accurate Codex claimed percentage, zero card text overlaps/clips, and WCAG AA contrast compliance
impact_assessment.risks: Contract: none; Dependency: none; Concurrency: none; State: UI-only rendering and CSS layout rules
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve existing DOM IDs, data attributes, and CSS selector anchors; verify in real Edge via Playwright screenshot inspection and unit tests

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Verified cockpit audio state sync, human-readable system/commodity names, Codex claimed %, card line-clamp reset, and WCAG AA faction contrast across 16 tabs in real Edge and 5/5 check gates
